description: Acceptance Test as a Service + escrow verdict: a neutral party runs the contract's tests on what was delivered. PASS/FAIL per test, escrow_verdict RELEASE/REFUND (OMENZ never holds funds: the payer acts on it), and a signed attestation that feeds the seller's Reputation Receipts. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/contract/accept, $0.005 via x402.)
